summary: Three registry inconsistencies found while building bible/characters/relationship.json. Relationship does not mint ids or edit the index; routed to memory-bible for character-manager / creature.

findings.issue: Registered under FAC-house-of-hearts in crown livery, but the source places him at the Duchess's door receiving the Queen's invitation for her (ch006#p02, ch006#p05-p18; FREL-001 describes a footman-to-footman hand-off between crown and Duchess household). relationship.json models CHAR-duchess -> CHAR-frog-footman master_servant as inferred.
findings.suggested_fix: character-manager reviews the faction: FAC-duchess-household (with Duchess livery) or keep crown livery with a reason. relationship.json follows whichever is confirmed.

findings.issue: doubling.note says Dinah 'is a real, on-screen animal and is registered by 04-creatures/creature', but bible/creatures/creature.json _meta.zero_entries_considered_and_excluded excludes Dinah as never shown on screen, and no CRE id exists for her.
findings.suggested_fix: Align the note with creature.json: Dinah is spoken of only (TERM-0025) and has no registry id. relationship.json anchors the echo on CHAR-alice -> CHAR-cheshire-cat dream_echo.

findings.issue: On screen in ev0026-ev0027 (ch006#p19-p49; SUP-006 one-shot transformation), handled by Alice for a whole scene, yet registered in neither characters/index.json nor creatures/index.json. Edges Duchess -> baby and Alice -> baby ('wouldn't it be murder to leave it behind?', ch006#p45) cannot be written without an id.
findings.suggested_fix: character-manager (a human infant performer per SUP-006) or creature (the pig at the end of the shot) registers an id; relationship.json then adds the two edges.

ruling: (a) Same ruling as DEF-p3-appearance-303-a: CHAR-frog-footman moves to FAC-duchess-household. relationship.json CHAR-duchess -> CHAR-frog-footman master_servant stands. (b) creature.json governs: Dinah is spoken of only (TERM-0025) and has no CRE id, so the index note is wrong. (c) The Duchess's baby is on screen for a full scene (ch006-p19..p49; SUP-006: an infant perceived gradually as pig-like). Per precedent P-007 (human performers register as CHAR-*), it is registered by character-manager.
fix_instruction: bible/characters/index.json: (a) see DEF-p3-appearance-303-a. (b) CHAR-cheshire-cat.doubling.note -> 'Dinah is spoken of only (TERM-0025), never shown on screen, and has no registry id (bible/creatures/creature.json _meta.zero_entries_considered_and_excluded).
